description: Add a new file version to an EXISTING document instead of creating a new document — e.g. a corrected scan, a signed copy, or an unlocked PDF. The new file becomes the current version: content, search and downloads follow it, and earlier versions stay listed in the document's `versions` (see get_document). Processing is asynchronous like post_document; set poll=true to wait. To strip a PDF password you don't need to re-upload: use edit_documents_bulk method remove_password with update_document=true.

file.description: Base64-encoded file content (the universal method — works for any deployment, since the bytes travel over the wire). Alternatively, an absolute file path (e.g. /tmp/invoice.pdf) that the server reads from its OWN filesystem — this only works when the server runs on the same machine as the file (local/stdio deployments). For a remote server, the path option will fail; use base64 instead.

id.description: The document to add the version to

poll.description: Wait for processing to finish (default false)

poll_timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait when poll=true (default 30)

version_label.description: Short label shown in the versions list, e.g. 'signed'

name: upload_document_version
